## Quality Standard: Pure Copper Armature vs. Aluminium
A fundamental differentiator for Techplus.pk is our strict 100% pure electrolytic copper motor policy. Low-grade tools frequently burn out due to copper-clad aluminium (CCA) windings that cannot dissipate heat during prolonged continuous work. Pure copper provides:
1. Higher electrical conductivity resulting in maximum sustained torque.
2. Heat resistance up to 200°C preventing burnt windings under load.
3. Resilience against low-voltage fluctuations common in Pakistan.

## Primary Tool Categories
### 1. Drill to Chainsaw Converters
Innovative attachments converting standard electric or cordless hand drills into functional chainsaws and reciprocating saws.
- Compatible with all 3-jaw chucks (10mm and 13mm).
- Hardened guide bar and alloy steel chain for clean wood, timber, and branch cutting.
- Ergonomic auxiliary handle for two-handed control.
- Typical pricing: Rs. 2,499 - Rs. 3,500.

### 2. Cordless Lithium-Ion Drills & Kits
Portable battery tools for mobile mechanics, woodworkers, and site installations.
- 18V & 21V platforms with dual rechargeable lithium-ion battery packs.
- 2-speed planetary gearbox (slow for screw driving, high speed for drilling).
- Integrated LED work light and forward/reverse rotation switch.

### 3. Industrial Rotary Hammers & Impact Drills
Heavy-duty hammer drills designed for masonry, concrete breaking, and brick anchor installations.
- 26mm rotary hammer units with SDS-plus chuck system and 3 selectable modes (drill, hammer drill, chisel).
- 710W high-speed impact machines with variable speed trigger.

### 4. Precision Pliers, Miter Shears & Hand Tools
- Multifunctional 9-in-1 electrician pliers (wire stripper, crimper, bolt cutter, needle nose).
- 45° to 135° adjustable miter shears for PVC trunking, plastic pipes, and wood molding.

## Service Operations (Islamabad & Rawalpindi)
Techplus provides certified technician visits for residential and commercial appliance servicing:
- Master AC Chemical Washing: Indoor coil dismantle, high-pressure jet wash, blower disinfection.
- Refrigerant Gas Top-Up: R22, R410A, and R32 pressure diagnostics and leak testing.
- Inverter PCB Diagnostics: Error code analysis, sensor replacement, and compressor checking.
- Solar Array Maintenance: High-pressure deionized panel washing for peak photovoltaic output.
